Database.// AutoMigrate: When true, pending EF Core migrations are applied to the database on app startup (e.g. after a publish/deploy). Set to false to manage the schema manually.

FaceEngine.// ApiKey: Shared key the face recognition engine sends as X-Face-Engine-Key (FRE_BACKEND_API_KEY). Empty = gallery endpoint disabled. Set it in appsettings.<env>.Local.json or the FaceEngine__ApiKey env var, never here.

App.Name: PAL GOLF
App.// PasswordSetupLinkHours: How long a set-password link stays valid.

// Mail:InlineImages: Inline-image limits for composed emails. The whole message must stay under 25 MB; base64 adds about 33%.
// theme: The look for emails, the pass page and meal stubs: theme.palgolf.json or theme.nxpass.json (or your own file beside the API). Same key and file as the web app's appSettings.json "theme".
